desc:
🚽 Toilet Warfare Defense is a tower defense game where TV Men, Speakermen and Cameramen fight back against invading toilets!

🎉 RELEASE: the Release Pack's EARLY SUPPORTER title is only available for the first 14 days!

⚔️ Place your units and hold the line across the City and the Outskirts
💀 Go from Easy to Nightmare and take down bosses like the G-Man and the Infected Titan Speakerman
🎲 Summon units and hunt for rare Shinies
🧪 Evolve your units in the Research Sector
🤝 Trade units and items with other players
💤 Earn free rolls in the AFK Zone
🏆 Daily rewards, quests, achievements and leaderboards
👥 Team up with friends or play solo

📱💻Play on mobile and PC!  🎮 Console support soon 

👍 Like and favorite the game to get notified of new updates!
